title: Дослідницький пошук
roles: R04 та інші з дослідницьким доступом
fields_and_relations: Дозволені результати/сегменти, терміни, facets, verification context.
required_interaction: Фільтри/зберегти запит/у корпус; прихований контент відсутній навіть у counts/snippets.

implementation.view_model: Scoped source search, explicit multi-selection, save-query dialog and corpus wizard
limitations: Search covers reader descriptions of information units, documents and carriers; indexed transcripts, segments and vocabulary facets remain pending.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store, fixture version 4; migration preserves existing edits and revoked grants
permissions: research.write in an explicit archive grant
domain.read rechecked for every source, note, assertion, citation and download
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, compare expected corpus/assertion revision, mutate clone, validate exact FK/versions and immutable corpus membership hashes, commit once.
